sentences.zh: 豆盧革，祖籍，同州刺史。

translations.literal: Dou Luge—his ancestral home is not recorded; he served as prefect of Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Luge, whose ancestral home is not recorded, served as prefect of Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 父瓚，舒州刺史。

translations.literal: His father Zan was prefect of Shuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zan was prefect of Shuzhou.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note:
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note:

sentences.zh: （《宣和書譜》云：失其世係。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Xuanhe Shupu》 says: his lineage was lost.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Xuanhe Catalog of Calligraphy》 states that his family line was lost.)〉

sentences.zh: 革少值亂離，避地鄜、延，轉入中山，王處直禮之，辟於幕下，有奏記之譽。

translations.literal: When young, Ge encountered the chaos of separation, fled to Fu and Yan, then went on to Zhongshan. Wang Chuzhi treated him with courtesy, recruited him to his staff, and he gained a reputation for memorial writing.
translations.idiomatic: In his youth Ge lived through the upheavals of the age, taking refuge in Fu and Yan before moving to Zhongshan. Wang Chuzhi received him graciously and brought him onto his staff, where he won renown for his memorials.

sentences.zh: 因牡丹會賦詩，諷處直以桑柘為意，言甚古雅，漸加器仰，轉節度判官。

translations.literal: At a peony gathering he composed a poem, using mulberry and catalpa as his theme to admonish Chuzhi; his language was very antique and elegant. Chuzhi gradually came to esteem him and promoted him to military governor's adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: At a peony festival he wrote a poem that, under the guise of mulberry and catalpa trees, admonished Chuzhi. The verse was strikingly refined, and Chuzhi came to value him more and more, eventually promoting him to adjutant of the military governorship.

sentences.zh: 而理家無法，獨請謁處直，處直慮布政有缺，有所規諫，斂版出迎，乃為嬖人祈軍職矣。

translations.literal: Yet in managing his household he had no discipline. He alone requested an audience with Chuzhi. Chuzhi, fearing gaps in his governance, came out with folded placard to welcome him and offer remonstrance—but Ge was actually seeking a military post for a favorite.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he ran his household without restraint and sought a private audience with Chuzhi. Chuzhi, worried that his own administration might be found wanting, came out with folded placard in hand ready to remonstrate—only to discover that Ge had come to secure a military appointment for a favorite.

sentences.zh: 天祐末，莊宗將即位，講求輔相，盧質以名家子舉之，征拜行台左丞相。

translations.literal: At the end of the Tianyou era, when Zhuangzong was about to ascend the throne, he sought chief ministers. Lu Zhi recommended Ge as a man of distinguished family, and he was summoned and appointed Left Chancellor of the Mobile Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Near the end of the Tianyou reign, as Zhuangzong prepared to take the throne, he looked for chief ministers. Lu Zhi recommended Ge as a scion of a great house, and Ge was summoned to serve as Left Chancellor of the Mobile Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 同光初，拜平章事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tongguang, he was appointed Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Tongguang era he was made Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 及登廊廟，事多錯亂，至於官階擬議，前後倒置，屢為省郎蕭希甫駿正，革改之，無難色。

translations.literal: Once he entered the court hall, affairs were often confused; even in proposing official ranks, earlier and later were reversed. He was repeatedly corrected by Secretariat Registrar Xiao Xifu, and Ge would change accordingly without showing displeasure.
translations.idiomatic: Once he reached the highest council, his handling of affairs was often muddled—even rank proposals were put in the wrong order. Secretariat Registrar Xiao Xifu corrected him again and again, and Ge would revise his decisions without a trace of resentment.

sentences.zh: 莊宗初定汴、洛，革引薦韋說，冀諳事體，與己同功。

translations.literal: When Zhuangzong first secured Bian and Luoyang, Ge recommended Wei Shuo, hoping he would understand administrative matters and share the work with him.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong first secured Bianzhou and Luoyang, Ge recommended Wei Shuo, hoping that Shuo understood how government worked and would share the burden with him.

sentences.zh: 說既登庸，復事流品，舉止輕脫，怨歸於革。

translations.literal: Once Shuo took office, he again devoted himself to pedigree and rank; his conduct was frivolous, and resentment fell on Ge.
translations.idiomatic: After Shuo took high office, he again busied himself with pedigree and rank while behaving with careless levity, and public blame fell on Ge for having brought him in.

sentences.zh: 又革、說之子俱授拾遺，父子同官，為人所刺，遂改授員外郎。

translations.literal: Moreover, both Ge's and Shuo's sons were appointed Reminder censors; father and son holding the same office drew criticism, so they were changed to Outside Regulars.
translations.idiomatic: Both Ge's and Shuo's sons were also appointed Reminder censors, and the spectacle of fathers and sons serving in the same office drew sharp criticism, so the appointments were changed to outside regular posts.

sentences.zh: 革請說之子濤為宏文館學士，說請革之子升為集賢學士，交易市恩，有同市井，識者醜之。

translations.literal: Ge requested Shuo's son Tao as Academician of the Hongwen Hall; Shuo requested Ge's son Sheng as Academician of the Jixian Institute—trading favors like peddlers in a market; those who knew them were ashamed.
translations.idiomatic: Ge secured Shuo's son Tao a post as academician of the Hongwen Hall, while Shuo secured Ge's son Sheng a post as academician of the Jixian Institute. They traded favors like market hawkers, and men of judgment were disgusted.

sentences.zh: 革自作相之後，不以進賢勸能為務，唯事修煉，求長生之術；

translations.literal: After Ge became chief minister himself, he did not make promoting the worthy and encouraging talent his task, but only devoted himself to refining elixirs and seeking the art of long life;
translations.idiomatic: After Ge became chief minister, he no longer made promoting the worthy and encouraging talent his concern, but devoted himself solely to alchemical refinement in search of the art of long life;

sentences.zh: 嘗服丹砂，嘔血數日，垂死而愈。

translations.literal: He once took cinnabar and vomited blood for several days, nearly dying before recovering.
translations.idiomatic: he once ingested cinnabar, vomited blood for days, and was near death before he recovered.

sentences.zh: 天成初，將葬莊宗，以革為山陵使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tiancheng, when Zhuangzong was to be buried, Ge was made Commissioner for the Imperial Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tiancheng era, as Zhuangzong was to be buried, Ge was appointed commissioner for the imperial mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 及木主歸廟，不出私第，專俟旄鎮，數日無耗，為親友促令入朝。

translations.literal: When the spirit tablet returned to the ancestral temple, he did not leave his private residence, waiting solely for appointment as military governor. For days there was no word; kin and friends urged him to enter court.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirit tablet had been returned to the ancestral temple, he stayed in his private residence, waiting only for appointment as military governor. Days passed without word, until kinsmen and friends pressed him to attend court.

sentences.zh: 安重誨對眾辱之曰：「山陵使名銜尚在，不候新命，便履公朝，意謂邊人可欺也。

translations.literal: An Chonghui publicly humiliated him, saying: "The title of Commissioner for the Imperial Mausoleum is still in place; without awaiting a new appointment he treads the public court—he must think men of the border may be deceived.
translations.idiomatic: An Chonghui humiliated him before the assembly, saying, "The title of mausoleum commissioner is still on the books. Without waiting for a new appointment you walk into open court—you must think a man from the frontier can be fooled.

sentences.zh: 」側目者聞之，思有所中。

translations.literal: " Those who looked askance heard this and thought to strike him somehow.
translations.idiomatic: " Those who already watched him with suspicion heard this and began to look for a way to bring him down.

sentences.zh: 初，蕭希甫有正諫之望，革嘗阻之，遂上疏論革與說苟且自容，致君無狀。

translations.literal: Earlier Xiao Xifu had hoped for upright remonstrance; Ge had once blocked him. Xifu then submitted a memorial attacking Ge and Shuo for compromising themselves and serving the ruler without propriety.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Xifu had earlier hoped to serve as a forthright remonstrator, but Ge had once stood in his way. Xifu now submitted a memorial charging that Ge and Shuo compromised themselves to stay in office and had served their ruler without propriety.

sentences.zh: 復誣其縱田客殺人，冒元亨上第。

translations.literal: He further accused Ge of letting his tenant farmers kill people and of fraudulently taking top honors in the Yuanheng examination.
translations.idiomatic: He further accused Ge of allowing tenant farmers to commit murder and of fraudulently obtaining the top rank in the Yuanheng examination.

sentences.zh: 遂貶為辰州刺史，仍令所在馳驛發遣。

translations.literal: Ge was therefore demoted to prefect of Chenzhou, and orders were given for the locality to dispatch him by express relay.
translations.idiomatic: Ge was demoted to prefect of Chenzhou, with orders that the local authorities dispatch him by express relay.

sentences.zh: 後鄭玨、任圜等連上三章，請不行後命，乃下製曰：「豆盧革、韋說等，身為輔相，手握權衡，或端坐稱臣，或半笑奏事，於君無禮，舉世寧容。

translations.literal: Later Zheng Jue, Ren Huan, and others jointly submitted three memorials asking that the later order not be carried out. An edict was then issued: "Dou Luge, Wei Shuo, and others, as chief ministers holding the scales of power, either sat upright styling themselves ministers or half-smiled when reporting affairs—to the ruler without courtesy; none in the world could tolerate it.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zheng Jue, Ren Huan, and others submitted three memorials in succession asking that the later order not stand. An edict was then issued: "Dou Luge, Wei Shuo, and the rest, as chief ministers holding the scales of power, either sat stiffly styling themselves ministers or half-smiled when reporting affairs. Such conduct toward the ruler is without courtesy; none in the world could tolerate it.

sentences.zh: 革則暫委利權，便私俸祿，文武百辟皆從五月起支，父子二人偏自正初給遣。

translations.literal: Ge temporarily entrusted profitable authority and took private salary for himself; all civil and military officials had salaries paid from the fifth month, but father and son alone had theirs from the first of the year.
translations.idiomatic: Ge temporarily entrusted profitable authority to himself and took private salary: all civil and military officials had their pay begin in the fifth month, but father and son alone drew theirs from the first of the year.

sentences.zh: 說則自居重位，全紊大綱。

translations.literal: Shuo, occupying a weighty position, wholly disrupted the great framework.
translations.idiomatic: Shuo, occupying a weighty post, wholly disrupted the great framework of government.

sentences.zh: 敘蔭貪榮，亂兒孫於昭穆；

translations.literal: Relying on inherited privilege for glory, he disorderly placed descendants in the ancestral hall;
translations.idiomatic: He sought glory through inherited privilege and disorderly placed descendants in the ancestral hall;

sentences.zh: 賣官潤屋，換令錄之身名。

translations.literal: selling offices to enrich his house, exchanging register names for posts.
translations.idiomatic: sold offices to enrich his house and traded register names for appointments.

sentences.zh: 醜行疊彰，群情共怒，雖居牧守，示塞非尤。

translations.literal: Ugly conduct piled up, popular feeling shared anger; though given governorships, this was to show that serious fault was not overlooked.
translations.idiomatic: Their ugly conduct piled up and popular anger was shared. Though they were given governorships, this was to show that serious fault would not be overlooked.

sentences.zh: 革可責授費州司戶參軍，說可夷州司戶參軍，皆員外置同正員，並所在馳驛發遣。

translations.literal: Ge may be stripped and appointed Registrar of Feizhou; Shuo may be appointed Registrar of Yizhou—both as supplemental appointees with the same standing as regular, and each locality shall dispatch them by express relay.
translations.idiomatic: Ge is stripped of rank and appointed registrar of Feizhou; Shuo is appointed registrar of Yizhou. Both are supplemental appointees with standing equal to regular posts, and each locality shall dispatch them by express relay.

sentences.zh: 」尋貶陵州長流百姓，委長吏常知所在。

translations.literal: " Shortly after, they were demoted to commoners banished to Lingzhou, with orders for the local chief official constantly to know their whereabouts.
translations.idiomatic: " Shortly afterward they were demoted to commoners banished to Lingzhou, with orders that the local chief official always know their whereabouts.

sentences.zh: 天成二年夏，詔令逐處刺史監賜自盡，其骨肉並放逐便。

translations.literal: In the summer of the second year of Tiancheng, an edict ordered the prefect in each place to supervise and grant them suicide; their kin were all banished as well.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the second year of Tiancheng, an edict ordered the prefect in each place to supervise and grant them suicide, and their kin were all banished forthwith.

sentences.zh: 子升，官至檢校正郎，服金紫，尋亦削奪。

translations.literal: His son Sheng reached the post of Examining Rectifier, wore gold and purple, and soon was stripped of these too.
translations.idiomatic: His son Sheng had risen to examining rectifier and wore gold and purple insignia, but soon lost these honors as well.

sentences.zh: （《寶晉齋法書讚》載豆盧革《田園帖》云：大德欲要一居處，畿甸間舊無田園，鄜州雖有三兩處莊子，緣百姓租佃多年，累有令公大王書請，卻給還人戶，蓋不欲侵奪疲民，兼慮無知之輩，妄有影庇包役云云。

translations.literal: (The 《Baojinzhai Fashu Zan》 records Dou Luge's 《Pastoral Letter》, which says: "Great Virtue wishes to have a residence. In the capital region I formerly had no estate. Although Fu Prefecture has two or three manor farms, because the common people have rented them for many years, there have repeatedly been letters from the Lord Prince requesting them back to the households. This is because I do not wish to seize from weary folk, and also fear that ignorant persons might falsely shelter others or bundle corvée labor," and so on.)
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Baojinzhai Praise of Calligraphy》 records Dou Luge's 《Pastoral Letter》, which reads in part: "Great Virtue wishes to have a dwelling. In the capital region I formerly had no estate. Although Fu Prefecture has two or three manor farms, the common people have rented them for many years, and there have repeatedly been letters from the Lord Prince asking that they be returned to the tenants. I do not wish to seize from weary folk, and I also fear that ignorant persons might falsely shelter others or bundle corvée obligations," and so on.)

sentences.zh: 嶽珂曰：此帖乃與僧往還書，其畏強藩避罪罟，蓋栗栗淵冰，然其後卒以故縱田客貶夜郎，正坐所畏，信乎亂邦之不可居也。

translations.literal: Yue Ke says: This letter is correspondence with a monk. His fear of powerful frontier lords and avoidance of the net of punishment were like treading on thin ice over a deep abyss—yet afterward he was ultimately banished to Yelang for letting tenant farmers run wild, exactly the thing he had feared. Truly, a chaotic state is no place to dwell.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Ke remarks: This letter is correspondence with a monk. His fear of powerful frontier lords and his effort to avoid the net of punishment were like treading on thin ice over a deep abyss—yet in the end he was banished to Yelang for letting tenant farmers run wild, precisely the danger he had feared. Truly, a chaotic age is no place to live.

sentences.zh: 是時據鄜乃高萬興，官檢校太師、中書令，封北平王，即革所謂「令公大王」者。

translations.literal: At that time the holder of Fu was Gao Wanxing, whose titles were Acting Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat, enfeoffed as Prince of Beiping—the "Lord Prince" of whom Ge spoke.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Fu was held by Gao Wanxing, whose titles were acting grand preceptor and director of the secretariat and who was enfeoffed as Prince of Beiping—the "Lord Prince" to whom Ge referred.

sentences.zh: 官故梁授，唐命維新，而顓麵正朝者，不能致褫鞶之誅，而反竊貢秉旄之佞，唐之不競，有自來矣。）〉

translations.literal: His offices had been granted by Liang; Tang had renewed its mandate—yet those who faced the court with solemn countenance could not bring down the punishment of stripping his regalia, but instead secretly accepted tribute from this holder of the commander's staff. That Tang could not contend had long been so.)〉
translations.idiomatic: His offices had been granted by Liang, and Tang had renewed its mandate—yet those who faced the court with solemn countenance could not bring down the punishment of stripping his regalia, but instead secretly accepted tribute from this frontier commander. That Tang could not contend had been clear for a long time.)〉

sentences.zh: 韋說，福建觀察使岫之子也。

translations.literal: Wei Shuo was the son of Wei Yu, Fujian military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Shuo was the son of Wei Yu, military commissioner of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 莊宗定汴、洛，說與趙光允同製拜平章事。

translations.literal: When Zhuangzong secured Bian and Luoyang, Shuo and Zhao Guangyun were jointly appointed Grand Councilors by edict.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong secured Bianzhou and Luoyang, Shuo and Zhao Guangyun were jointly appointed as grand councilors by edict.

sentences.zh: 說性謹重，奉職常不造事端。

translations.literal: Shuo's nature was cautious and grave; in office he ordinarily did not create incidents.
translations.idiomatic: Shuo was cautious and grave by nature and ordinarily did not stir up trouble in office.

sentences.zh: 時郭崇韜秉政，說等承順而已，政事得失，無所措言。

translations.literal: At the time Guo Chongtao held power; Shuo and the others merely complied, and on the gains and losses of government they had nothing to say.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Chongtao held power at the time, and Shuo and the others merely followed his lead, with nothing to say about what government got right or wrong.

sentences.zh: 初，或有言於崇韜，銓選逾濫，選人或取他人出身銜，或取父兄資緒，與令史囊橐罔冒，崇韜乃條奏其事。

translations.literal: Earlier someone had told Chongtao that selection was excessively lax—candidates took others' examination credentials, or used fathers' and elder brothers' qualifications, colluding with clerks for bribes and false claims. Chongtao then submitted a detailed memorial on the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Someone had earlier told Chongtao that appointments were excessively lax: candidates took others' examination credentials or borrowed fathers' and elder brothers' qualifications, while clerks took bribes for false claims. Chongtao then submitted a detailed memorial on the matter.

sentences.zh: 其後郊天，行事官數千人，多有告敕偽濫，因定去留，塗毀告身者甚眾，選人號哭都門之外。

translations.literal: Afterward, at the suburban sacrifice, several thousand participating officials were found to have many forged or excessive appointment documents. When retention and dismissal were decided, many had their credentials defaced; candidates wailed outside the capital gate.
translations.idiomatic: Later, at the suburban sacrifice to Heaven, several thousand participating officials were found to hold many forged or improper appointment documents. When retention and dismissal were decided, many credentials were defaced, and candidates wailed outside the capital gate.

sentences.zh: 議者亦以為積弊累年，一旦澄汰太細，懼失惟新含垢之意。

translations.literal: Commentators also held that abuses had accumulated for years, and that to purge too finely at once feared losing the intent of renewal and forbearance.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators also held that abuses had piled up for years, and that to purge too finely at once risked losing the spirit of renewal and forbearance.

sentences.zh: 時說與郭崇韜國列，不能執而止之，頗遭物議。

translations.literal: At the time Shuo held equal rank with Guo Chongtao but could not hold firm and stop it, and he drew considerable public criticism.
translations.idiomatic: Shuo then held equal rank with Guo Chongtao but could not hold firm and stop the purge, and he drew considerable public criticism.

sentences.zh: 說之親黨告之，說曰：「此郭漢子之意也。

translations.literal: Shuo's kinsmen and associates informed him; Shuo said: "This is that Guo fellow's idea.
translations.idiomatic: Shuo's kinsmen and associates told him of the criticism. Shuo said, "This is that Guo fellow's idea.

sentences.zh: 」及崇韜得罪，說懼流言所鍾，乃令門人左拾遺王鬆、吏部員外郎李慎儀等上疏，云：「崇韜往日專權，不閑故實，塞仕進之門，非獎善之道。

translations.literal: " When Chongtao fell from grace, Shuo feared being targeted by rumor and had his disciples Left Reminder Wang Song and Ministry of Personnel Outside Regular Li Shenyi submit a memorial saying: "Chongtao in the past monopolized power, was unversed in precedent, blocked the gate of advancement, and this is not the way to reward the good.
translations.idiomatic: " When Chongtao fell from grace, Shuo feared being targeted by rumor and had his disciples Left Reminder Wang Song and Ministry of Personnel Outside Regular Li Shenyi submit a memorial saying, "Chongtao in the past monopolized power, was unversed in precedent, blocked the gate of advancement, and this is not the way to reward the good.

sentences.zh: 」疏下中書，說等覆奏，深詆崇韜，識者非之。

translations.literal: " The memorial was sent down to the Secretariat; Shuo and the others replied with a memorial deeply denouncing Chongtao, and men of judgment disapproved.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was sent down to the Secretariat, and Shuo and the others replied with a memorial that deeply denounced Chongtao. Men of judgment disapproved.

sentences.zh: 又有王傪者，能以多岐取事，納賂於說，說以其名犯祖諱，遂改之為「操」，擬官於近甸。

translations.literal: There was also a Wang Can who could gain affairs by many devious paths and paid bribes to Shuo. Shuo, because his name violated an ancestral taboo, changed it to "Cao" and proposed an appointment in the near capital districts.
translations.idiomatic: There was also a Wang Can who could secure appointments by many devious paths and paid bribes to Shuo. Because his name violated an ancestral taboo, Shuo changed it to "Cao" and proposed an appointment in the near capital districts.

sentences.zh: 及明宗即位，說常慮身危，每求庇於任圜，常保護之。

translations.literal: When Mingzong took the throne, Shuo often feared for his safety and repeatedly sought protection from Ren Huan, who regularly shielded him.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingzong took the throne, Shuo often feared for his safety and repeatedly sought protection from Ren Huan, who regularly shielded him.

sentences.zh: 說居有井，昔與鄰家共之，因嫌鄙雜，築垣於外。

translations.literal: Shuo's residence had a well that he had formerly shared with a neighbor. Disliking the vulgar crowding, he built a wall on the outside.
translations.idiomatic: Shuo's residence had a well that he had once shared with a neighbor. Disliking the vulgar crowding, he built a wall around it.

sentences.zh: 鄰人訟之，為希甫疏論，以為井有貨財，及案之本人，惟稱有破釜一所，反招虛妄。

translations.literal: The neighbor sued. Xifu discussed it in a memorial, holding that the well held property of value; when the case was investigated, the man himself said only that there was one broken cauldron, which instead invited the charge of falsehood.
translations.idiomatic: The neighbor sued. Xifu discussed the case in a memorial, arguing that the well held property of value; when the case was investigated, the man himself said only that there was one broken cauldron, which instead invited the charge of falsehood.

sentences.zh: 初貶敘州刺史，尋責授夷州司戶參軍。

translations.literal: He was first demoted to prefect of Xuzhou, then stripped and appointed Registrar of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was first demoted to prefect of Xuzhou, then stripped of rank and appointed registrar of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 初，說在江陵，與高季興相知，及入中書，亦常通信幣。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Shuo was at Jiangling, he knew Gao Jixing well; after entering the Secretariat he also often exchanged letters and gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Shuo was at Jiangling, he was on good terms with Gao Jixing, and after he entered the Secretariat they still often exchanged letters and gifts.

sentences.zh: 自討西蜀，季興請攻峽內，莊宗許之：「如能得三州，俾為屬郡。

translations.literal: When the campaign against Western Shu began, Jixing requested to attack the inner gorges. Zhuangzong assented: "If you can take the three prefectures, they shall be made your dependent commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: When the campaign against Western Shu began, Jixing asked to attack the inner gorges. Zhuangzong agreed: "If you can take the three prefectures, they shall be made your dependent commanderies.

sentences.zh: 」西川既定，季興無尺寸之功。

translations.literal: " When Western Shu was settled, Jixing had not a fraction of merit.
translations.idiomatic: " When Western Shu was settled, Jixing had not earned a fraction of merit.

sentences.zh: 洎明宗纘承，季興頻請三郡，朝廷不得已而與之。

translations.literal: When Mingzong succeeded to the throne, Jixing repeatedly requested the three commanderies, and the court, having no choice, granted them.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingzong succeeded to the throne, Jixing repeatedly asked for the three commanderies, and the court, having no choice, granted them.

sentences.zh: 革、說方在中書，亦預其議。

translations.literal: Ge and Shuo were then in the Secretariat and also took part in the deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Ge and Shuo were then in the Secretariat and also took part in the deliberation.

sentences.zh: 及季興占據，獨歸其罪，流於合州。

translations.literal: When Jixing occupied them, the blame alone was laid on Shuo, and he was banished to Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Jixing occupied the territories, the blame alone was laid on Shuo, and he was banished to Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 明年夏，詔曰：「陵州、合州長流百姓豆盧革、韋說，頃在先朝，擢居重任，欺公害物，黷貨賣官。

translations.literal: The next summer an edict said: "The banished commoners Dou Luge of Lingzhou and Wei Shuo of Hezhou were recently raised to weighty posts in the former court, harmed the public and injured things, took bribes and sold offices.
translations.idiomatic: The next summer an edict said, "The banished commoners Dou Luge of Lingzhou and Wei Shuo of Hezhou were recently raised to weighty posts in the former court. They harmed the public, injured the realm, took bribes, and sold offices.

sentences.zh: 靜惟肇亂之端，更有難容之事，且夔、忠、萬三州，地連巴蜀，路扼荊蠻，藉皇都弭難之初，徇逆帥僭求之勢，罔予視聽，率意割移。

translations.literal: Reflecting quietly on the origin of disorder, there is still more that cannot be tolerated: moreover the three prefectures of Kui, Zhong, and Wan border Ba-Shu and straddle the road that throttles Jing and Man. Taking advantage of the capital's first effort to quell difficulty, they yielded to a rebellious commander's presumptuous demands, disregarded Our sight and hearing, and willfully ceded territory.
translations.idiomatic: On quiet reflection, the origin of disorder has still more that cannot be tolerated. The three prefectures of Kui, Zhong, and Wan border Ba-Shu and straddle the route that throttles Jing and the southern tribes. Taking advantage of the capital's first effort to quell turmoil, they yielded to a rebellious commander's presumptuous demands, disregarded Our authority, and willfully ceded territory.

sentences.zh: 將千之土疆，開通狡穴；

translations.literal: A thousand li of territory was about to be opened to cunning lairs;
translations.idiomatic: A thousand li of territory was about to be opened to cunning lairs;

sentences.zh: 動兩川之兵賦，禦捍經年。

translations.literal: the military levies of the two Shu were stirred, and defense lasted for years.
translations.idiomatic: the military levies of the two Shu were stirred, and defense dragged on for years.

sentences.zh: 致朕莫遂偃戈，猶煩運策。

translations.literal: This caused Us not to lay down Our weapons, and strategy was still troubled.
translations.idiomatic: This kept Us from laying down Our weapons and still troubled Our strategy.

sentences.zh: 近者西方鄴雖復要害，高季興尚固窠巢，增吾旰食之憂，職爾朋奸之計。

translations.literal: Recently, though the western Ye stronghold was recovered, Gao Jixing still held his nest, increasing Our anxiety at mealtimes—it was the work of your faction's scheming.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, though the western Ye stronghold was recovered, Gao Jixing still held his nest, increasing Our anxiety at mealtimes—this was the work of your faction's scheming.

sentences.zh: 而又自居貶所，繼出流言。

translations.literal: Moreover, while dwelling in their place of demotion, they continued to spread slander.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, while dwelling in their places of demotion, they continued to spread slander.

sentences.zh: 苟刑戮之稽時，處忠良於何地？

translations.literal: If punishment is delayed, where shall the loyal and good stand?
translations.idiomatic: If punishment is delayed, where shall the loyal and good stand?

sentences.zh: 宜令逐處刺史監賜自盡。」

translations.literal: Let the prefect in each place be ordered to supervise and grant them suicide."
translations.idiomatic: Let the prefect in each place be ordered to supervise and grant them suicide."

translations.idiomatic: 〈Note:

sentences.zh: （《歐陽史》：說子濤，晉天福初，為尚書膳部員外郎，卒。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Ouyang History》: Shuo's son Tao, at the beginning of Jin Tianfu, was Outside Regular of the Ministry of Rites Provisioners Section and died.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The 《New History of the Five Dynasties》: Shuo's son Tao, at the beginning of the Jin Tianfu era, served as outside regular of the Ministry of Rites Provisioners Section and died.)〉

sentences.zh: 盧程，唐朝右族。

translations.literal: Lu Cheng was of a great Tang clan on the right.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Cheng came from a great Tang clan of the establishment.

sentences.zh: 祖懿，父蘊，曆仕通顯。

translations.literal: His grandfather Yi and father Yun both served in prominent posts through their careers.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Yi and father Yun had both served in prominent posts through their careers.

sentences.zh: 程，天復末登進士第，崔魏公領鹽鐵，署為巡官。

translations.literal: Cheng passed the jinshi examination at the end of Tianfu. When Duke Cui of Wei headed the Salt and Iron Commission, he appointed Cheng as touring official.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng passed the jinshi examination near the end of the Tianfu era. When Duke Cui of Wei headed the Salt and Iron Commission, he appointed Cheng touring official.

sentences.zh: 昭宗遷洛陽，柳璨陷右族，程避地河朔，客遊燕、趙，或衣道士服，幹謁藩伯，人未知之。

translations.literal: When Zhaozong moved to Luoyang, Liu Can persecuted the great clans of the right. Cheng fled to Heshuo and traveled as a guest in Yan and Zhao, sometimes wearing Daoist robes and seeking audiences with frontier lords, and people did not know who he was.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhaozong moved to Luoyang, Liu Can persecuted the great establishment clans. Cheng fled to Heshuo and wandered as a guest in Yan and Zhao, sometimes wearing Daoist robes and seeking audiences with frontier lords, and people did not know who he was.

sentences.zh: 豆盧革客遊中山，依王處直，盧汝弼來太原。

translations.literal: Dou Luge traveled as a guest to Zhongshan and relied on Wang Chuzhi; Lu Rubi came to Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Luge had traveled as a guest to Zhongshan and relied on Wang Chuzhi, while Lu Rubi came to Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 程與革、弼皆朝族知舊，因往來依革，處直禮遇未優，故投於太原；

translations.literal: Cheng, Ge, and Bi were all old acquaintances among court clans. Cheng therefore went to rely on Ge, but Chuzhi's courtesy was not generous, so he went on to Taiyuan;
translations.idiomatic: Cheng, Ge, and Bi were all old acquaintances among court clans. Cheng therefore went to rely on Ge, but Chuzhi's courtesy was not generous, so he went on to Taiyuan;

sentences.zh: 汝弼因為延譽，莊宗署為推官，尋改支使。

translations.literal: Rubi recommended him, and Zhuangzong appointed Cheng investigating officer, soon changing the post to administrative aide.
translations.idiomatic: Rubi recommended him, and Zhuangzong appointed Cheng investigating officer, soon changing the post to administrative aide.

sentences.zh: 程褊淺無他才，惟矜恃門第，口多是非，篤厚君子尤薄之。

translations.literal: Cheng was narrow and shallow, without other talent; he only prided himself on pedigree, his mouth full of right and wrong, and earnest gentlemen especially despised him.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng was narrow and shallow and had no other talent. He prided himself only on pedigree, his mouth full of gossip, and earnest gentlemen especially despised him.

sentences.zh: 初，判官王緘從軍掌文翰，胡柳之役，緘歿於軍。

translations.literal: Earlier, adjutant Wang Jian followed the army in charge of documents; in the battle at Huliu, Jian died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, adjutant Wang Jian had followed the army in charge of documents; at the battle of Huliu he died in the field.

sentences.zh: 莊宗歸寧太原，置酒公宴，舉酒謂張承業曰：「予今於此會取一書記，先以卮酒辟之。

translations.literal: Zhuangzong returned to Taiyuan to pay respects and held a public banquet. He raised his cup and said to Zhang Chengye: "I shall now at this gathering choose a secretary. First I offer this cup of wine to declare the choice.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong returned to Taiyuan to pay his respects and held a public banquet. He raised his cup and said to Zhang Chengye, "At this gathering I shall choose a secretary. First I offer this cup of wine to declare the choice.

sentences.zh: 」即舉酒屬巡官馮道，道以所舉非次，抗酒辭避。

translations.literal: " He at once offered the wine to touring official Feng Dao. Dao, because the appointment was out of order, raised the cup in refusal and declined.
translations.idiomatic: " He at once offered the wine to touring official Feng Dao. Because the appointment was out of order, Dao raised the cup in refusal and declined.

sentences.zh: 莊宗曰：「勿謙挹，無逾於卿也。

translations.literal: Zhuangzong said: "Do not be modest—none surpasses you.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong said, "Do not be modest—none surpasses you.

sentences.zh: 」時以職列序遷，則程當為書記，汝弼亦左右之。

translations.literal: " At the time, by order of rank in office, Cheng ought to have become secretary, and Rubi also supported him.
translations.idiomatic: " By order of rank in office, Cheng ought to have become secretary, and Rubi also supported him.

sentences.zh: 程既失職，私懷憤惋，謂人曰：「主上不重人物，使田里兒居餘上。

translations.literal: Cheng, having lost the post, privately harbored resentment and said to others: "Our lord does not value men of quality, letting a village lad rank above me.
translations.idiomatic: Having lost the post, Cheng privately harbored resentment and said to others, "Our lord does not value men of quality, letting a village lad rank above me.

sentences.zh: 」先是，莊宗嘗於帳中召程草奏，程曰：「叨忝成名，不閑筆硯。

translations.literal: " Earlier Zhuangzong had once summoned Cheng in his tent to draft a memorial. Cheng said: "I have undeservedly achieved fame and am unskilled with brush and inkstone.
translations.idiomatic: " Earlier Zhuangzong had once summoned Cheng in his tent to draft a memorial. Cheng said, "I have undeservedly achieved fame and am unskilled with brush and inkstone.

sentences.zh: 」由是文翰之選，不及於程。

translations.literal: " For this reason the choice for documents did not reach Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: " For this reason the choice for documents did not reach Cheng.

sentences.zh: 時張承業專製河東留守事，人皆敬憚。

translations.literal: At the time Zhang Chengye monopolized the Hedong regent's affairs, and all feared and respected him.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhang Chengye monopolized the Hedong regent's affairs, and all feared and respected him.

sentences.zh: 舊例，支使監諸廩出納，程訴於承業曰：「此事非仆所長，請擇能者。

translations.literal: By old custom the administrative aide supervised all granary receipts and disbursements. Cheng complained to Chengye: "This matter is not what your servant excels at; please choose someone capable.
translations.idiomatic: By old custom the administrative aide supervised all granary receipts and disbursements. Cheng complained to Chengye, "This matter is not what your servant excels at; please choose someone capable.

sentences.zh: 」承業叱之曰：「公稱文士，即合飛文染翰，以濟霸國，嘗命草辭，自陳短拙，及留職務，又以為辭，公所能者何也？

translations.literal: " Chengye rebuked him: "You call yourself a man of letters, so you ought to wield the brush and aid the hegemonic state. When ordered to draft a text you declared your inadequacy; when left with duties you again make excuses—what can you do?
translations.idiomatic: " Chengye rebuked him: "You call yourself a man of letters, so you ought to wield the brush and aid the hegemonic state. When ordered to draft a text you declared your inadequacy; when left with duties you again make excuses—what can you do?

sentences.zh: 」程垂泣謝之。

translations.literal: " Cheng wept and apologized.
translations.idiomatic: " Cheng wept and apologized.

sentences.zh: 後曆觀察判官。

translations.literal: Later he served successively as observation commissioner adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: Later he served successively as observation commissioner adjutant.

sentences.zh: 及汴將王彥章陷德勝南城，爭攻楊劉，莊宗禦軍苦戰，臣下憂之，鹹白宰臣，欲連章規諫，請不躬禦士伍。

translations.literal: When Bian general Wang Yanzhang took the south city of Desheng and strove to attack Yangliu, Zhuangzong led the army in bitter fighting. His ministers were anxious; all told the chief ministers they wished to submit joint memorials of remonstrance asking that he not personally lead the ranks.
translations.idiomatic: When the Bian general Wang Yanzhang took the south city of Desheng and pressed the attack on Yangliu, Zhuangzong led the army in bitter fighting. His ministers were anxious; all told the chief ministers they wished to submit joint memorials asking that he not personally lead the ranks.

sentences.zh: 豆盧革言及漢高臨廣武事，矢及於胸，紿雲中足。

translations.literal: Dou Luge spoke of Emperor Gaozu of Han at Guangwu, where an arrow reached his chest and he deceived Yunzhong into staying.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Luge spoke of Emperor Gaozu of Han at Guangwu, where an arrow reached his chest and he deceived Yunzhong into staying.

sentences.zh: 程曰：「此劉季失策。

translations.literal: Cheng said: "This was Liu Ji's mistake in strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng said, "That was Liu Ji's mistake in strategy.

sentences.zh: 」眾皆縮頸。

translations.literal: " All shrank their necks.
translations.idiomatic: " Everyone shrank back.

sentences.zh: 嘗論近世士族，或曰：「員外郎孔明龜，善和宰相之令緒，宣聖之係孫，得非盛歟！

translations.literal: Once when discussing recent scholar-official clans, someone said: "Outside Regular Kong Minggui of Shanhe was a descendant of a chief minister's line and a collateral descendant of the Sage—can this not be splendid!
translations.idiomatic: Once when discussing recent scholar-official clans, someone said, "Outside Regular Kong Minggui of Shanhe was a descendant of a chief minister's line and a collateral descendant of the Sage—can this not be splendid!

sentences.zh: 」程曰：「止於孔子之後，盛則吾不知也。

translations.literal: " Cheng said: "He is only a descendant of Confucius; as for splendor, I do not know.
translations.idiomatic: " Cheng said, "He is only a descendant of Confucius; as for splendor, I do not know.

sentences.zh: 」親黨有假驢夫於程者，程帖府給之，府吏訴雲無例，程怒鞭吏背。

translations.literal: " A kinsman had borrowed a donkey driver from Cheng; Cheng posted an order at the prefectural office to provide one. A clerk complained that there was no precedent; Cheng angrily whipped the clerk's back.
translations.idiomatic: " A kinsman had asked Cheng to lend him a donkey driver; Cheng posted an order at the prefectural office to supply one. When a clerk protested that there was no precedent, Cheng flew into a rage and had the clerk flogged.

sentences.zh: 時任圜為興唐少尹，莊宗從姊婿也，憑其寵戚，因詣程。

translations.literal: At the time Ren Huan was Vice Governor of Xingtang and son-in-law of Zhuangzong's elder cousin sister; relying on imperial favor, he therefore went to see Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Ren Huan served as vice governor of Xingtang and was son-in-law to Zhuangzong's elder cousin's daughter. Relying on his imperial connections, he went to see Cheng.

sentences.zh: 程方衣鶴氅、華陽巾，憑幾決事，見圜怒詈曰：「是何蟲豸，恃婦力耶！

translations.literal: Cheng was wearing a crane cloak and Huayang cap, leaning on a desk deciding affairs. Seeing Huan he angrily cursed: "What kind of vermin is this, relying on a woman's strength!
translations.idiomatic: Cheng was dressed in a crane cloak and Huayang cap, leaning on his desk to decide affairs. When he saw Huan he cursed in fury: "What kind of vermin is this, leaning on a woman's strength!

sentences.zh: 宰相取給於府縣，得不識舊體！

translations.literal: A chief minister taking supplies from the prefecture and county—can you not know the old forms!
translations.idiomatic: A chief minister drawing supplies from the prefecture and county—have you no knowledge of the old forms!

sentences.zh: 」圜不言而退，是夜，馳至博平，麵訴於莊宗。

translations.literal: " Huan left without a word. That night he galloped to Boping and complained face to face to Zhuangzong.
translations.idiomatic: " Huan left without a word. That night he galloped to Boping and laid his grievance before Zhuangzong in person.

sentences.zh: 莊宗怒，謂郭崇韜曰：「朕誤相此癡物，敢辱予九卿。

translations.literal: Zhuangzong was angry and said to Guo Chongtao: "We wrongly made this fool chief minister; he dares insult Our Nine Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong was furious and said to Guo Chongtao, "We wrongly made this fool chief minister; he dares insult Our Nine Ministers.

sentences.zh: 」促令自盡。

translations.literal: " He urged him to kill himself.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered him to take his own life at once.

sentences.zh: 崇韜亦怒，事幾不測，賴盧質橫身解之，遂降為右庶子。

translations.literal: Chongtao was also angry; the affair nearly became unpredictable. Thanks to Lu Zhi throwing himself in the way to mediate, Cheng was demoted to Right Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Chongtao was angry as well, and the affair nearly turned deadly. Only when Lu Zhi threw himself in the way to mediate was Cheng spared and demoted to right censor.

sentences.zh: 莊宗既定河南，程隨百官從幸洛陽，沿路墜馬，因病風而卒。

translations.literal: When Zhuangzong had settled Henan, Cheng followed the hundred officials in attending the emperor to Luoyang. Along the road he fell from his horse and died of apoplexy.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhuangzong secured Henan, Cheng followed the officials in attending the emperor to Luoyang. Along the road he fell from his horse and died of a stroke.

sentences.zh: 贈禮部尚書。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously awarded the title of minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 趙鳳，幽州人也。

translations.literal: Zhao Feng was a man of Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Feng was a native of Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 少為儒。

translations.literal: In his youth he was a Confucian scholar.
translations.idiomatic: In his youth he was a Confucian scholar.

sentences.zh: 唐天祐中，燕帥劉守光盡率部內丁夫為軍伍，而黥其面，為儒者患之。

translations.literal: In Tang Tianyou, Yan commander Liu Shouguang conscripted all men in his jurisdiction into the army and tattooed their faces; scholars were distressed by this.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tang Tianyou era, the Yan commander Liu Shouguang conscripted every able-bodied man in his domain into the army and tattooed their faces, which distressed the scholarly class.

sentences.zh: 多為僧以避之，鳳亦落發至太原。

translations.literal: Many became monks to avoid it; Feng also shaved his head and went to Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Many became monks to escape conscription; Feng too shaved his head and went to Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 頃之，從劉守奇奔梁，梁用守奇為博州刺史，表鳳為判官。

translations.literal: Before long he followed Liu Shouqi in fleeing to Liang. Liang employed Shouqi as prefect of Bozhou and recommended Feng as adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he followed Liu Shouqi in fleeing to Liang. Liang appointed Shouqi prefect of Bozhou and recommended Feng as his adjutant.

translations.idiomatic: 〈Note:
